tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background — off-white by default, near-black in the dark theme. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and inputs, one step up from canvas. Separate with line hairlines, never shadows.

tokens.name: canvas-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed strips: footer, caption bars, quiet section breaks.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-bleed black bands (hero, 'The work', booking, footer). Text on it is on-band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text, marks and the focus ring on a band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card outlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Column rules, input borders, table heads; also rules on band. 3:1 on canvas and canvas-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas, canvas-raised and canvas-sunk. Also the primary button fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, descriptions and captions on canvas, canvas-raised and canvas-sunk.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Neutral grey for non-text marks: dividers inside photos, placeholder fills, disabled controls. Never text.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The one accent — the shop's wall green. Use sparingly: primary-button hover, the text-link underline, active nav, selected states. As text, on canvas and canvas-raised only. Fills take on-green.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on a green fill.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only, always with a word ('Card declined'). As text, on canvas and canvas-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on canvas, canvas-raised and canvas-sunk. On band, the ring is on-band.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter Tight ExtraBold, tracked in hard. Every headline is ALL CAPS, stacked in a narrow column like signage.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: GOOD GROOMING STARTS WITH BEING UNDERSTOOD.
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. All caps.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Service, card and column headings. All caps.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter. Labels are all caps and widely spaced; reading text is sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section numbers, nav, buttons, place lines. All caps.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Not sure what to do with your hair? We'll help you figure it out.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a section title. Sentence case, max 60 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A haircut designed to fit your face shape, hair, routine, and lifestyle.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and service descriptions. Sentence case, max 68 characters a line.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: 45 min · we'll show you how to style it at home

groups.name: Logo lettering
groups.note: EB Garamond is the lettering of the Broken Arrow logo. Use it only to make new logo lockups (e.g. a future EDUCATION version) from the existing ones — never for headlines or UI.

styles.name: logo-name
styles.usage: The name in the lockup, EB Garamond Medium, all caps. Reference only — use the logo files.

styles.name: logo-descriptor
styles.usage: The descriptor line under the name, between two rules. Reference only — use the logo files.

spacing.note: 8px grid with a 4px half-step. Be generous: sections breathe at space-12 and up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-text gaps, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tight controls; between a label and its headline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutter on phones; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop; between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Above and below hero headlines.

radius.note: Square, like cut stock and tool steel. Nothing is ever pill-shaped.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for blocks, photos, bands and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags — just enough to soften the edge.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules between rows, card outlines (colour: line).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Section-top rules, focus ring, secondary button outline.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width inside the page margins.
